name: @mesh/glass-material
description: Shared liquid-glass surface, text, accent, rim and shadow roles. Defaults follow any theme; themes tune them with an @module block.

tokens.glass.text.heading: var(--color-on-surface)
tokens.glass.text.caption: var(--color-on-surface-variant)
tokens.glass.surface.pill: linear-gradient(to bottom, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface-container-high) 30%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface-container) 20%, transparent))
tokens.glass.surface.recording: linear-gradient(to bottom, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-error-container) 50%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-error) 32%, transparent))
tokens.glass.surface.weather: linear-gradient(to bottom, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface-container) 24%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface-container-low) 18%, transparent))
tokens.glass.surface.media: linear-gradient(to bottom, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface-container-high) 24%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface-container-low) 18%, transparent))
tokens.glass.surface.dock: linear-gradient(to bottom, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface-container-high) 36%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface-container) 22%, transparent))
tokens.glass.surface.flare: linear-gradient(to bottom, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface-container-high) 23%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface-container) 22%, transparent))
tokens.glass.surface.lens: linear-gradient(to bottom, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface-container-highest) 37%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface-container-high) 17%, transparent))
tokens.glass.surface.focused: linear-gradient(to bottom, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary-container) 45%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-secondary-container) 30%, transparent))
tokens.glass.surface.battery: linear-gradient(to bottom, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary-container) 90%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary-container) 80%, transparent))
tokens.glass.surface.battery.low: linear-gradient(to bottom, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-error-container) 90%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-error-container) 80%, transparent))
tokens.glass.surface.control: linear-gradient(to bottom, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-secondary-container) 30%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface-container-high) 20%, transparent))
tokens.glass.surface.panel: linear-gradient(to bottom, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface-container-high) 70%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface-container-low) 54%, transparent))
tokens.glass.meter.bar: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--color-tertiary), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 55%, transparent))
